title: 西門子MAGNETOM Terra磁振系統
summary: 以「高場磁體的均勻度、射頻與量測假體」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「場強標稱值被當成全容積均勻度」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.title: 單元1｜磁振頻率尺度：機制與界面

steps.objectiveEn: Complete mechanism and interfaces for High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「高場磁體的均勻度、射頻與量測假體」。畫出「磁場 → 射頻介面 → 接收線圈 → 取樣重建 → 數位假體」並圈出與「磁振頻率尺度」有關的介面。將 gamma*field 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：指定核種的拉莫爾頻率與磁場成正比；此例gamma是質子近似值。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：只估頻率尺度，不是掃描序列、射頻功率或人體安全設定。
steps.instructionEn: The case focus is High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology. Draw Magnetic field → RF interface → Receive coil → Sampling and reconstruction → Digital phantom and mark the interfaces relevant to Magnetic resonance frequency scale. Place every variable of gamma*field on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: For a specified nucleus, Larmor frequency is proportional to field; gamma here approximates the proton value. Identify what it cannot establish: A frequency-scale estimate, not a scan sequence, RF power or human safety setting.

steps.failureEn: Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity; A frequency-scale estimate, not a scan sequence, RF power or human safety setting.

steps.title: 單元1｜磁振頻率尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Magnetic resonance frequency scale: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「高場磁體的均勻度、射頻與量測假體」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「高場磁體的均勻度、射頻與量測假體」的「磁振頻率尺度」採以下合成教學值：gamma=42.577 MHz/T；field=0.01 T。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 gamma*field；獨立基準為 0.42577 MHz。把 gamma 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 0.468347 MHz。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology, use synthetic inputs for Magnetic resonance frequency scale: gamma=42.577 MHz/T；field=0.01 T. Check dimensions before evaluating gamma*field; the independent benchmark is 0.42577 MHz. Increase gamma by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 0.468347 MHz. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: gamma增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 0.042577 MHz。只估頻率尺度，不是掃描序列、射頻功率或人體安全設定。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 0.042577 MHz. A frequency-scale estimate, not a scan sequence, RF power or human safety setting.
steps.failure: 場強標稱值被當成全容積均勻度；只估頻率尺度，不是掃描序列、射頻功率或人體安全設定。
steps.failureEn: Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity; A frequency-scale estimate, not a scan sequence, RF power or human safety setting.
steps.check: 原值重算與 0.42577 MHz 相符；10%案例與 0.468347 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 0.42577 MHz at baseline and 0.468347 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（MHz）？
quiz.explanation: 按 gamma*field 逐項代入，結果為 0.42577；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into gamma*field gives 0.42577; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜磁振頻率尺度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Magnetic resonance frequency scale: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「高場磁體的均勻度、射頻與量測假體」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「高場磁體的均勻度、射頻與量測假體」設計「磁振頻率尺度」的獨立驗證：以數位磁場偏差換算頻率偏差，分清T、mT、Hz與MHz。 僅用數位假體比較頻率、訊雜比和幾何一致性，不含病人或掃描操作。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology, independently verify Magnetic resonance frequency scale: Convert digital field deviations into frequency shifts, distinguishing T, mT, Hz and MHz. Use digital phantoms only to compare frequency, SNR and geometry; no patient or scanning procedure. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「場強標稱值被當成全容積均勻度」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 場強標稱值被當成全容積均勻度；只估頻率尺度，不是掃描序列、射頻功率或人體安全設定。
steps.failureEn: Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity; A frequency-scale estimate, not a scan sequence, RF power or human safety setting.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「只估頻率尺度，不是掃描序列、射頻功率或人體安全設定。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state A frequency-scale estimate, not a scan sequence, RF power or human safety setting.

steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「場強標稱值被當成全容積均勻度」。以本單元「磁振頻率尺度」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以數位磁場偏差換算頻率偏差，分清T、mT、Hz與MHz。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity. For Magnetic resonance frequency scale, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Convert digital field deviations into frequency shifts, distinguishing T, mT, Hz and MHz. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.

steps.instruction: 本課焦點「高場磁體的均勻度、射頻與量測假體」的「訊號雜訊比」採以下合成教學值：signal=100 count；background=25 count；noise=5 count RMS。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 signal/sqrt(signal+background+noise**2)；獨立基準為 8.16496581 1。把 signal 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 8.69626357 1。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology, use synthetic inputs for Signal-to-noise ratio: signal=100 count；background=25 count；noise=5 count RMS. Check dimensions before evaluating signal/sqrt(signal+background+noise**2); the independent benchmark is 8.16496581 1. Increase signal by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 8.69626357 1. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: signal增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 0.531297756 1。假設泊松計數與獨立雜訊；相關條紋、漂移及偏置不滿足此式。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 0.531297756 1. Assumes Poisson counts and independence; correlated stripes, drift and bias violate the model.
steps.failure: 場強標稱值被當成全容積均勻度；假設泊松計數與獨立雜訊；相關條紋、漂移及偏置不滿足此式。
steps.failureEn: Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity; Assumes Poisson counts and independence; correlated stripes, drift and bias violate the model.
steps.check: 原值重算與 8.16496581 1 相符；10%案例與 8.69626357 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 8.16496581 1 at baseline and 8.69626357 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（1）？
quiz.explanation: 按 signal/sqrt(signal+background+noise**2) 逐項代入，結果為 8.16496581；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into signal/sqrt(signal+background+noise**2) gives 8.16496581; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元2｜訊號雜訊比：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Signal-to-noise ratio: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「高場磁體的均勻度、射頻與量測假體」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「高場磁體的均勻度、射頻與量測假體」設計「訊號雜訊比」的獨立驗證：保留暗場、背景與訊號三組重複資料，分別估計平均與變異。 僅用數位假體比較頻率、訊雜比和幾何一致性，不含病人或掃描操作。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology, independently verify Signal-to-noise ratio: Retain repeated dark, background and signal data; estimate means and variances separately. Use digital phantoms only to compare frequency, SNR and geometry; no patient or scanning procedure. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「場強標稱值被當成全容積均勻度」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 場強標稱值被當成全容積均勻度；假設泊松計數與獨立雜訊；相關條紋、漂移及偏置不滿足此式。
steps.failureEn: Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity; Assumes Poisson counts and independence; correlated stripes, drift and bias violate the model.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「假設泊松計數與獨立雜訊；相關條紋、漂移及偏置不滿足此式。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Assumes Poisson counts and independence; correlated stripes, drift and bias violate the model.

optionsEn: Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Retain repeated dark, background and signal data; estimate means and variances separately.

quiz.explanationEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Assumes Poisson counts and independence; correlated stripes, drift and bias violate the model.

steps.title: 單元2｜訊號雜訊比：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Signal-to-noise ratio: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「高場磁體的均勻度、射頻與量測假體」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「場強標稱值被當成全容積均勻度」。以本單元「訊號雜訊比」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「保留暗場、背景與訊號三組重複資料，分別估計平均與變異。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity. For Signal-to-noise ratio, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Retain repeated dark, background and signal data; estimate means and variances separately. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「場強標稱值被當成全容積均勻度」不是單靠 8.16496581 1 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 8.16496581 1 alone cannot exclude Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 場強標稱值被當成全容積均勻度；假設泊松計數與獨立雜訊；相關條紋、漂移及偏置不滿足此式。
steps.failureEn: Nominal field treated as volume-wide uniformity; Assumes Poisson counts and independence; correlated stripes, drift and bias violate the model.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「高場磁體的均勻度、射頻與量測假體」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for High-field magnet homogeneity, RF chain and phantom metrology and retaining failed cases.
